entry.title: Golf.com: Secret Envelopes, Unruly Fans, Europe Domination: Unpacking the 2025 Ryder Cup
entry.summary:
TL;DR
Europe edged out the U.S. 15–13 at Bethpage Black to reclaim the 2025 Ryder Cup, overcoming a raucous American crowd and a late Stateside charge. Behind the scenes, the so-called “envelope rule” sparked plenty of chatter about clutch captain’s picks and strategy. Looking ahead, golf’s biggest team event may never be the same: unruly fans on both sides, envelope drama and Europe’s resurgence all raise fresh questions about formats, course setups and whether the U.S. can reclaim home-field mojo in 2027. Watch on YouTube
